description: This file contains unit tests for the UpdateThing class, focusing on immutability, equality/hash code correctness, and serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: UpdateThingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the immutability, equality, hash code, and serialization behavior of the UpdateThing class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of UpdateThing are immutable using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Ensures that UpdateThing has correct hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of UpdateThing objects to/from JSON.
